leadIn: By the end of this lesson, learners will be able to:
objectives: Install and import the required packages (react-hook-form, zod, @hookform/resolvers) into a React TypeScript project.
Define a Zod schema to specify validation rules for form fields (e.g., required, min length, email format).
Apply the useForm hook from react-hook-form to initialize form state and control within a React component.
Utilize the zodResolver from @hookform/resolvers to connect the Zod schema with react-hook-form's validation.
Construct form input elements (like text inputs) and register them with react-hook-form using the register function.
Implement form submission handling by defining an onSubmit function that processes validated form data.
Control the display of validation errors by accessing the errors object from react-hook-form and conditionally rendering error messages.
Modify form field properties (e.g., type, placeholder) and apply validation attributes directly through the register function.
Invoke the handleSubmit function from react-hook-form to trigger validation and submission logic on form submit events.
Store and retrieve form state values (like default values) using the defaultValues option in the useForm configuration.
Compare different validation strategies by applying Zod's built-in methods (e.g., .min(), .email()) versus custom validation logic.
Return structured form data with proper TypeScript types inferred from the Zod schema for type-safe submission handling.
lessonTitle: Form Validation with Zod + React Hook Form
